summary: Flag overlapping twtḥ and ṭwṭḥ paradigms for consolidation
rationale: Lookup ṭwṭḥ confirms mṭawṭaḥle/mṭawṭəḥ with the same lowering gloss and active Preterit/Infectum. Current twtḥ contributes Detransitive and Imperativ evidence; spellings overlap in assigned LuF forms. No other entry is changed and no etymology is transferred automatically.

summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (PrS 86/10)

data.turoyo: Gənwət laḥmo me emox, kəmqaṣqəṣatle bag garme, kobatle lu kumsoḥro, kəmtawtaḥle li mʕarṯo — u laḥmo.
data.translation: Du stiehlst deiner Mutter Brot, zermalmst es mit Knochen gibst es einem Rotkopf, und der lässt es in eine Höle hinunterfallen. (Das Brot; die Knochen sind die Zähne, der Rotkopf die Zunge).

rationale: First active Infectum box for this spelling entry; suffixed bread patient and l-goal in a riddle. No new descent sense.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (76/171)

data.turoyo: Mədle, zbəṭle qarʕe d Kayalo w mtawtaḥle bi kowayo hul laltaḥ. Naḥət ṭarm našifo.
data.translation: Das Grindköpfchen faßt den Kopf von Kayalo und läßt ihn durch die Dachluke hinunterfallen. Er kommt mausetot unten an.

rationale: First active Preterit box locally; human patient, b-route through roof opening and downward endpoint.

summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) hinuntergehen, hinabgelangen; sich hinunterlassen
rationale: Makes explicit the unnumbered Detransitive reading already exemplified by southward motion. LuF 2/20 and 2/33 add uncontrolled and voluntary descent without agent L-suffix; emphatic spellings are retained as provisional variants.

data.turoyo: Mḥela raġla bu təštawo w annaqla u tašt ʕal u talgo xriq w mṭawṭəḥ l arʕe du šalwo.
data.translation: gab sie dem Zuber einen Fusstritt, und dieser sauste auf dem Schnee zu Tal.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Preterit cell; inanimate tub undergoes descent after a kick, contrasting voluntary motion.

data.turoyo: Hama aṯino, ḥzeli kowo, mṭawṭaḥno bi kowo, naḥətno bayn a ʕwonani diḏux.
data.translation: Schliesslich gelangte ich zu einer Dachluke, liess mich durch sie hinab und kam unten bei deinen Schafen an.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Preterit cell; first-person voluntary descent, no ruḥi object or -li agent suffix.

summary: Preserve the glossary's stem I classification for this four-consonant root; reader descriptions of a Q-shaped formation do not authorize relabeling it Q.

Active lowering has an external actor and patient (suffix or understood), with b-route or l-goal. Detransitive descent includes both deliberate self-motion and externally initiated tub motion; it is not restricted to an external-agent passive.

The LuF emphatic forms are recorded under the assigned root provisionally. Lookup of ṭwṭḥ reveals the same lowering gloss and active lowering, including mṭawṭaḥle ruḥe: an overt reflexive object contrasts with no-object mṭawṭaḥno in LuF 2/33.
Legacy prs 15/21 and prs 105/35 are preserved; matching supplied passages use PrS 6/36 and PrS 39/34. Do not duplicate or assume older locators are wrong.
Should twtḥ and ṭwṭḥ be consolidated as spelling variants? Establish phonology and etymology before transferring the Arabic derivation from ṭwṭḥ.
Confirm the Detransitive no-agent-suffix paradigm mṭawṭəḥ/mṭawṭaḥno against the inherited mtawṭəḥ and source mtawtaḥ. The t/ṭ and vocalism differences are retained.
Does inherited southward laltaḥ require a geographical specialization, or is it a contextual directional extension of descent as proposed?
